name: Concrete Volume Calculator
description: Calculate concrete volume needed for slabs, footings, or columns from dimensions.

seo.title: Concrete Volume Calculator - Free Online
seo.description: Concrete Volume Calculator — Calculate concrete volume needed for slabs, footings, or columns from dimensions with instant results & multiple unit support.

formula.explanation: Volume = Length × Width × Thickness. All dimensions converted to meters, result in m³.

content.introduction: Calculate the volume of concrete needed for a slab, footing, or rectangular structural element. Add 5-10% extra for waste and uneven subgrade.

example.description: A 10m × 5m × 150mm thick slab requires 7.5 m³ of concrete.

faq.q: How much extra concrete should I order?
faq.a: Add 5-10% to account for waste, over-excavation, and uneven subgrade. For large flatwork, 5% is usually sufficient.

faq.q: What does 1 m³ of concrete weigh?
faq.a: Normal weight concrete weighs approximately 2400 kg/m³.

faq.q: How do I convert concrete volume between m³ and yd³?
faq.a: 1 m³ = 1.308 yd³. For example, 10 m³ = 13.08 yd³. Ready-mix concrete is often ordered in cubic yards in the US, so convert before placing an order.
